Dependency-only release — no `app/` changes, no new env vars, no config changes, no migration. Patches PyJWT (CVE-2026-101918, not reachable here) and certifi (PYSEC-2026-4320), bumps the runtime stack (FastAPI, Uvicorn, cryptography) and the pinned Python base-image digest, and adds the OpenSSF Best Practices badge to the README. Safe to take whenever convenient.

### Security
- **README now shows the OpenSSF Best Practices badge** — the project achieved the passing badge (project [#15112](https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/15112)), closing Scorecard's `CIIBestPracticesID` finding, the last of the 18 original findings left after v0.5.14. Registered and self-assessed against all ~70 passing-level criteria (basics, change control, reporting, quality, security, analysis), matching `admitto`/`mail-autodiscover`'s existing badges
- **Bumped PyJWT 2.14.0 → 2.15.1** — patches [CVE-2026-101918](https://github.com/jpadilla/pyjwt/security/advisories/GHSA-42vr-xj54-vc7v) (unauthenticated `RecursionError` DoS via a recursively nested payload in `PyJWKClient.get_signing_key_from_jwt` / `jwt.decode(..., verify_signature=False)`). Not reachable in this codebase — `app/crypto.py` only calls `jwt.encode()` to sign outbound SETs; it never decodes or verifies a JWT, and never uses `PyJWKClient` — but caught by `pip-audit` in CI and worth clearing regardless. All five hash-pinned lockfiles (`requirements.txt` and the four extras) regenerated to match
- **Bumped certifi 2026.7.22 → 2026.10.19** — patches PYSEC-2026-4320, flagged by `pip-audit` in CI. Transitive (via `httpx`/`httpcore`, which verify receiver TLS certificates); all five hash-pinned lockfiles regenerated to match

### Changed
- **Routine dependency bumps** — runtime: `fastapi` 0.141.1 → 0.143.0, `uvicorn` 0.53.0 → 0.54.0, `cryptography` 50.0.1 → 50.0.2 (plus `opentelemetry-api` 1.45.1 now pulled in transitively); dev/CI tooling: `ruff` 0.16.9 → 0.17.0, `mypy` 2.3.1 → 2.4.0, `hypothesis` → 6.170.2, `pip-tools` 7.6.1 → 7.6.2; the `python` base-image digest in the `Dockerfile` and `.clusterfuzzlite/Dockerfile`; and several GitHub Actions (`SonarSource/sonarqube-scan-action`, `actions/upload-artifact`, `actions/download-artifact`, the CodeQL action group). `pip-tools` 7.6.2 no longer writes `--no-index` into lockfile headers, so that flag was dropped from all six `requirements*.txt` headers to keep the `dependency-lock` drift check green
